text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- An alliance of Pro Patria & Moderates and the Electoral Union Tartu 2000 elected MP Tonis Lukas as Mayor of Estonia's second city of Tartu.
- Representatives of the International Monetary Fund said at a meeting with Prime Minister Tiit Vahi that they were satisfied with the country's economic performance this year.
- Journalist Madis Jurgen could face charges for making a false report to the police about the theft of his car. Jurgen was testing the alertness of the police.
- Several Estonian dairies will start exporting milk powder and cheese to Brazil.
